# mcp-sso

> OAuth 2.1 for remote MCP servers: a resource-server verifier for `/mcp` plus an authorization-server bridge that speaks CIMD or `POST /oauth/register`, PKCE, and consent to MCP clients while an upstream identity provider stays the identity source. TypeScript, `jose` is the only runtime dependency.

Each line names a page, its kind (tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation, history), and what it is for. Current pages describe the source tree at the commit you are reading; history pages describe the date in their heading and are not current reference. Rules for changing this repository are in AGENTS.md.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): explanation. The problem, the flow, what ships, the trust artifacts, when to use something else.
- [Get started](docs/getting-started.md): tutorial. The loopback server with console pairing, then the identity-provider path with the repository example.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): reference. Every page routed by "I want to" and by kind.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): reference for agents. Invariants, gates, the pull-request checklist, the writing standard, the decision-disclosure format.

## How-to guides

- [Configure client registration](docs/client-registration.md): how-to. CIMD and `POST /oauth/register`, stateless or stored, loopback callbacks for CLI clients.
- [Provision a machine client](docs/machine-clients.md): how-to. `client_credentials`, out-of-band provisioning, rotation, custom `MachineClientStore` rules.
- [Deploy an API-key gateway](docs/gateway-deployment.md): how-to. SSO in front of a backend that only accepts a static key.
- [Deploy an audit sink](docs/audit-deployment.md): how-to. JSONL file, webhook, combined sinks, what never appears in an event.
- [Configure an identity provider](docs/identity/README.md): how-to index for Cloudflare Access, Microsoft Entra ID, Google, generic OIDC, and the unshipped GitHub port.
- [Run live client verification](docs/live-verification.md): how-to. The harness, provider legs, real MCP clients.
- [Prepare a release](docs/release-checklist.md): how-to. Gates, release matrix, exact-head review, tag and publish.
- [Troubleshoot a deployment](docs/troubleshooting.md): how-to. Symptoms to causes.

## Reference

- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): reference. Environment variables and `BridgeConfig` fields.
- [Capabilities and deployment limits](docs/reference/capabilities.md): reference. What the package ships and what one bridge can protect.
- [Contracts index](docs/contracts.md): reference. Change routing into the 18 numbered contract files under `docs/contracts/`.
- [Threat model](docs/threat-model.md): reference. Assets, trust boundaries, required controls, 48 attacker-driven rows, deployment-facing residuals.
- [Spec conformance matrix](docs/contracts/16-spec-conformance-matrix.md): reference. MCP Authorization 2026-07-28 and CIMD draft -00, row by row, deviations recorded.
- [Verification status](docs/verification-status.md): reference. The published release, the current source tree, and what the last live campaign did and did not prove.

- [Release verification requirements](docs/verification.md): reference. The `RM.N` release-matrix rows that `scripts/check-release-matrix.mjs` binds to tests.

- [Live verification harness](docs/reference/live-harness.md): reference. What each script under `scripts/live/` can establish.
- [Dependency ledger](docs/dependency-ledger.md): reference. Every pin, its publish date, the 15-day floor, and the advisory exceptions.

## Explanation

- [OAuth roles and flow](docs/explanation/oauth-roles-and-flow.md): explanation. Who proves what, why the bridge mints its own token, where a request can stop.
- [Client registration choices](docs/explanation/client-registration-choices.md): explanation. CIMD versus stateless versus stored DCR and what each protects.
- [Redirect URI trust](docs/explanation/redirect-uri-trust.md): explanation. Why redirect checks use exact strings and re-check on every read.
- [Rate limits and client IP trust](docs/explanation/rate-limits-and-client-ip.md): explanation. Why a limiter is only as good as the IP it keys on, proxies, replicas, the stored-registration 503.
- [Rate-limit outage policy](docs/rate-limit-outage-policy.md): explanation. Why `POST /oauth/register` in stored mode fails closed and everything else continues.
- [CIMD fetch safety](docs/explanation/cimd-fetch-safety.md): explanation. Why a client-supplied URL the server fetches needs SSRF rules and one generic error.
- [Authorization model](docs/authorization.md): explanation. Identity-provider gates versus the bridge's own allowlists and scope ceilings.
- [Verification design](docs/verification-design.md): explanation. Why evidence has three tiers and why the release matrix is separate.
- [Live verification infrastructure](docs/explanation/live-verification-infrastructure.md): explanation. What the live harness needs and why.

## Contracts (normative)

- [docs/contracts/](docs/contracts.md): reference. Sections 1 to 18: purpose, the two roles, normative references, design principles, configuration, ports, crypto and tokens, the resource-server verifier, the bridge, redirect-URI policy, scopes, store conformance, audit, errors, package and exports, conformance matrix, feature contracts, and the change protocol. If code and a contract disagree, the contract wins until one is deliberately changed.
